newsitem.title: USA: Bank of NY seeks suspension of application.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NY seeks suspension of application.

text.p: Bank of New York Co Inc has asked the Federal Reserve to suspend processing of its application to raise its stake in State Street Corp to 9.99 percent from 4.9 percent, a spokesman said.
"The application was absolutely not withdrawn," the spokesman said.
He said Bank of New York sought the suspension April 14, the day it filed suit against the Massachusetts Board of Bank Incorporation seeking to overturn that body's denial of a smiliar application.
The spokesman said the suspension at the Fed was sought pending a "judicial determination."
